import pandas as pd

# Identify the Total row
total_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'total']

# Year columns (all except the last 'Total' column)
year_cols = df.columns[1:-1]

# Find years where total losses < 350,000
below = [col for col in year_cols if pd.to_numeric(total_row[col].iloc[0], errors='coerce') < 350000]

answer = below[0] if below else None
